description: Executes SQL against the database with AST validation. SELECT results are capped by MCP_QUERY_ROW_LIMIT (default 500, AST-injected LIMIT) and include a '-- rows: N (truncated at LIMIT X)' footer when the cap is reached. Unindexed full table scans above MCP_EXPLAIN_MAX_SCAN_ROWS are blocked before execution. Only the configured schema is reachable: SHOW statements, information_schema/mysql/performance_schema/sys, other schemas, server variables, SELECT ... INTO and functions such as LOAD_FILE or SLEEP are rejected by the server. To explore the schema use 'search_schema'.
name: heldfast_churn_placeholder_execute_safe_query
